description: Build a JSON Schema validator supporting core keywords
prompt: Write a Python module with: (1) `validate(instance, schema: dict) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]` that validates a JSON instance against a JSON Schema (draft-07 subset). Support these keywords: type (string, number, integer, boolean, array, object, null), required, properties, items, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, enum, pattern (regex), additionalProperties. Return (True, []) on success, (False, [list of error messages]) on failure. (2) class `SchemaError` raised for invalid schemas. Include test_validate() testing: type validation, required fields, nested objects, array items, pattern matching, multiple errors collected.
expected_behavior: Validates JSON instances against schema subset, collects all errors rather than failing on first

validation_criteria.l5: Handles nested validation, collects multiple errors, correct type coercion rules
